summary: Catalog-versioned ingest and atomic offline redaction maintenance passed retained remote regression tests. Final release source, signed bundle and native qualification remain pending. This file does not certify deployment corpus cleanliness.

catalog.fingerprint_algorithm: SHA-256 of domain frankenterm-secret-catalog-v2 NUL sequential-regex-replace-all NUL, then UTF-8 fields framed by u64 big-endian byte lengths: default marker, named marker template, and each ordered family name plus actual regex expression
catalog.reproducible: redactor::secret_catalog_version is canonical; the names below alone cannot reconstruct expression-sensitive identity. The retained remote catalog-identity and manifest-schema tests verified this fingerprint against the live implementation.

ingest_stamping.pre_v29_rows: NULL = catalog unknown; a successful non-dry-run sweep stamps the applied catalog on every scanned row atomically with its receipt. This column identifies the last applied catalog, not immutable capture provenance.

properties: idempotent content rewrites; every completed real sweep records a receipt including zero-rewrite scans
one SQLite transaction covers row rewrites, catalog adoption, configured SQLite derived-store maintenance, and mandatory receipt; failure rolls back
derived-store rebuild: output_segments_fts FTS5 + segment_embeddings invalidation

purge.note: run_redact_purge transaction, receipt and dry-run controls passed remotely. Only active-catalog matches are eligible. Sealed backups require separate review.

verification.claim: Scoped remote maintenance, catalog and backup regression proof; release manifest remains deferred until producing-bead bundle qualification completes.
verification.not_claimed: No whole-corpus cleanliness claim: scans are per-segment, resumed scans exclude earlier rows, and catalog coverage is finite. Tantivy rebuild_requested records required external work; no rebuild is queued or performed. mmap mirrors, archived backups and external indexes are not certified by a SQLite maintenance receipt.

retained_current_source_receipts.source_scope: Thirteen explicit overlays; redactor.rs, backup.rs and redactor/Cargo.toml match the implementation commit. redact_backfill.rs differs only by a corrected catalog-identity comment.
retained_current_source_receipts.aggregate_limit: Four unrelated core failures prevented an aggregate pass. The named redaction, backup and manifest-schema tests passed; this receipt does not upgrade the whole batch.
